name: Sewer Starwatch
image_style: Cinematic digital matte painting with restrained graphic-novel geometry, subtle cel-shaded character edges, damp stone and oxidized metal textures, and atmospheric green-black depth. Mood: mysterious, reverent, quietly humorous, like a hidden medieval stronghold repurposed as an impossible underground observatory. Palette: deep gruvbox-inspired forest greens, charcoal umber, muted parchment highlights, tarnished brass, and restrained crimson and yellow accents. Keep the top edge spacious and low-detail for desktop panels, with one calm shadowed region for widgets; no lettering or framing.
scene: A single 16:10 landscape wallpaper inside a vast hidden sewer base beneath an old Crusader-era city: vaulted stone tunnels, cleanly rendered historical masonry, narrow channels of dark water, moss, copper pipes, and a concealed observatory chamber opening toward the upper-right darkness. Space Ghost stands respectfully but conspicuously on a damp maintenance platform near the lower-right, recognizable in his muscular white costume, black hood and mask, yellow cape, and red power bands, solemnly examining an antique brass map table as though on a sacred military mission. A small medieval shield and sheathed sword rest undisturbed in the background as historical details, never props for ridicule. The affectionate visual joke comes from his extreme seriousness and obvious out-of-place presence; no worship, sacred parody, holy figures, devotional attributes, lettering, logos, UI, watermark, or frame. Quiet upper edge, spacious composition, calm widget-friendly shadow region.
source_phrase: Dark sewer spaceghost hidden base greens and gruvboxy
